text:
Repairing broken things gives me such immense satisfaction.

I just sewed up a hole in a dog bed, and it made me feel so accomplished.

I was scheduled to have jury duty last month, but I postponed it to the week of Thanksgiving.

I'm really hoping that I don't get called in!

It's my day off work!

What should I do?

(Probably work more on my website.)

Really looking forward to getting my new M-wave FM-1!

It should arrive any day. But do I install Baud Girl or Skiff first? (or one of the other 217 options?)

Thinking about onomatopoetic avian nomenclature.

Do you think crows were named for their vocalizations?

(Imagine if pelicans, flamingoes, or penguins were.)
I'm off to go read more Dungeon Crawler Carl!
I'm making a website! How fun!
